docs.home.body: Use JavaScript generator functions to write shajara routines that start concurrent work, wait at explicit points, and let scope boundaries handle cancellation and recovery.
docs.home.description: Documentation, Flow Explorer, and API Map for shajara.
docs.home.hero.tagline: Keep async work owned by the scope that starts it.
docs.home.title: Structured concurrency for JavaScript
explorer.examples.all-results.descriptio: all(...) starts several routines and returns one future for their ordered result.
explorer.examples.all-results.guide.futu: pageData is the future for the ordered result; wait(pageData) observes both values together.
explorer.examples.all-results.guide.work: renderDashboard starts loadUser and loadSettings through all(...).
explorer.examples.all-results.title: All Results
explorer.examples.bounded-channel.descri: A capacity-one channel shows when senders continue immediately and when they wait.
The draft send is accepted while channel capacity is available.
queueBatches creates a capacity-one channel and shares the receiver with writeBatches.
writeBatches receives later values as the waiting sends are accepted.
review and publish arrive while the buffer is full, so their sends wait.
explorer.examples.bounded-channel.title: Bounded Channel
explorer.examples.failure-driven-cancell: A child scope failure cancels the remaining work before the caller receives ScopeError.
launchCampaign enters branch(...) to run sendCampaign in a child scope.
When sendEmailBatch throws, the child scope cancels the work that is still sleeping.
sendEmailBatch, refreshAudience, and the sendCampaign entry process belong to that child scope.
branch(...) surfaces the scope failure inside launchCampaign.
explorer.examples.first-result.descripti: race(...) returns the first successful value after canceling the non-winning routine.
explorer.examples.first-result.guide.rac: loadProfile runs readCache and fetchNetwork in a race scope.
explorer.examples.first-result.guide.win: readCache wins; race(...) cancels fetchNetwork before returning the profile.
explorer.examples.first-result.title: First Result
explorer.examples.fork-join.description: spawn(...) starts work in the current scope; wait(...) observes each future later.
explorer.examples.fork-join.guide.fork: loadPage starts loadHeader and loadSidebar as processes in the current scope.
explorer.examples.fork-join.guide.join: loadPage waits for both futures before returning the combined page result.
explorer.examples.fork-join.title: Spawn and Wait
explorer.examples.future-settlement.desc: One routine waits on a future that another routine settles later.
explorer.examples.future-settlement.guid: receiveSmsCode settles smsCode with the received code.
verifyPhoneNumber waits at wait(smsCode) until that settlement arrives.
explorer.examples.recovery-boundary.desc: guard(...) handles a failed resumable(...) child scope at the recovery boundary.
explorer.examples.recovery-boundary.guid: publishListing enters guard(...), where reviewListing waits at resumable(...).
scanPhotos fails inside the child scope created by resumable(...).
approveManually handles the scope exit failure at the guard boundary.
The recovery value resumes reviewListing at the original wait point.
Futures and channels are canceled or revoked when their owning scope converges.
openSession creates ticket and updates inside its child scope.
When that child scope converges, it cancels the unfinished future and revokes the open channel.
resumeCheckout receives those handles, but their lifetime stays owned by openSession's scope.
Later wait(...) and tryReceive(...) observe those terminal states.
explorer.examples.scope-owned-work.descr: branch(...) waits for all work owned by its child scope before returning.
explorer.examples.scope-owned-work.guide: publishArticle enters branch(...) to run commitArticle in a child scope.
commitArticle returns published before updateSearchIndex finishes.
updateSearchIndex is spawned inside that child scope, so the child scope owns it.
branch(...) waits for updateSearchIndex before returning to publishArticle.
explorer.examples.scope-owned-work.title: Scope-Owned Work
explorer.examples.single-spawn.descripti: spawn(...) starts a process and lets the caller continue immediately.
explorer.examples.single-spawn.guide.cal: submitOrder returns order accepted without waiting for the receipt process.
explorer.examples.single-spawn.guide.spa: submitOrder starts sendReceiptEmail as a process in the current scope.
explorer.examples.single-spawn.title: Spawn Without Waiting
